source_record.title: Senior Unreal Engine Developer – Synthetic Data & AI Simulation
source_record.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

  • Develop scalable synthetic data generation pipelines using Unreal Engine 5
  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality Unreal Engine systems using C++, Python, Blueprints, and custom plugins
  • Develop tools and automation to improve simulation workflows and dataset generation
  • Create, integrate, and optimize realistic environments, assets, and rendering pipelines
  • Work extensively with Blender and 3D assets to build high-quality simulation environments
  • Generate synthetic datasets for computer vision applications including object detection, tracking, segmentation, and sensor simulation
  • Collaborate closely with AI, robotics, and computer vision engineers to continuously improve data quality and simulation realism
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and maintainability across the simulation pipeline


Your profile

  • 4+ years of professional experience developing software with Unreal Engine, game engines, simulation platforms, or comparable real-time 3D environments (Exceptional senior candidates are also encouraged to apply)
  • Strong professional experience developing with C++  
  • Strong Python programming skills for tooling, automation, and pipeline development
  • Practical experience using Blender for creating, editing, or optimizing 3D assets
  • Solid experience with Unreal Engine 5, including: C++ development, Plugin development, Blueprints, Asset integration
  • Experience building production-quality software rather than academic or hobby projects
  • Good understanding of rendering pipelines, simulation environments, or synthetic data generation
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows


Nice to have

  • Experience with synthetic data generation for AI or computer vision applications
  • Familiarity with robotics, autonomous systems, or simulation environments
  • Experience with procedural generation, digital twins, or geospatial datasets
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or StackIT 


What else

  • Intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset
  • Creative thinker with a structured and systematic approach
  • Humble and collaborative — prioritizes collective success over individual recognition
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic
  • Extra-curricular leadership or achievements are a bonus
  • Fluent in English, German is a plus
  • Nationality of a NATO member nation or close ally is required
